page.content:
When Sun Wukong came to the Dragon Palace of the East Sea in search of a weapon, Ao Guang had Commander Perch bring him a sword from the armoury, but Sun Wukong didn’t know how to use it properly.

Who is Commander Perch?

When Sun Wukong came to the Dragon Palace of the East Sea in search of a weapon, Ao Guang had Commander Perch bring him a sword from the armoury, but Sun Wukong didn’t know how to use it properly.
